question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Watching the singer perform live at the concert ________ (alert) the audience for a moment.
solution:
The correct answer is "**distracted**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Alert" means watching, listening, etc. for something with all your attention. **(सतर्क, चौकन्‍ना)

 
 
• Example: The soldiers need to be alert all the time.
 
 
 
 
 
• Antonym of "alert" is "distracted".
 
 
• **"Distracted" means to be unable to concentrate or focus on something.**(विचलित)
 
 
• Example: She seemed distracted during the session.
 
 
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the audience was distracted momentarily while watching the singer perform live at the concert.

Hence,** the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (shunned) means to avoid or reject something, which does not fit the context of the sentence.(दूर करना)
 
• Option 3 (called) means to communicate with someone or to make a request, which is not relevant to the given sentence.(बुलाया)
